## Evaluation Status (ES)

The outcome of evaluating one rule against one subject: `pass`, `fail`, `partial`, `not-applicable`, `unproven` or `pending`, with `isConclusive` derived (true for the first four). `unproven` is the honest state of a control that satisfied the rule on paper but attached no evidence — it counts against coverage in a report, never as a pass, which is why it is a distinct value and not a pass with a flag.

```ts
import { EvaluationStatusField } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/records/evaluation-status-field';
@field status = contains(EvaluationStatusField);
```

Only verdicts are coloured (pass green, fail red, partial amber); the three inconclusive states render slate on purpose.

## Example
The contained example is `unproven` — the state the standard exists to make visible.

## Non-goals
Not a lifecycle: a result does not transition, it is written once by the Audit command and superseded by a later run. Not a finding's status (open / in-remediation / closed) — that lives on the Finding. Carries no severity; a fail's severity comes from the rule.
